timingRules.pauseIsAnimation: holds are intentional timing choices, not missing motion

motionPrinciples: contact and passing poses for walks
eye/head attention may precede body motion
holds may be longer for comedy, reaction, or readability
do not move baked screenshot panels

walkCycle.timing: chosen per shot; commonly on 2s at 24 fps, with 1s for fast accents and longer holds for stops/reactions

actingShotRule: look/attention changes, gesture preparation, action, settle, and reaction can each have separate exposures
